question.question: When Vagabond takes a hit, which item must be chosen, where does it go, does its face change, and can already-damaged items absorb another hit?

expected.expected_answer: Choose one undamaged item and move it to Damaged box, keeping its current face. Cannot select an already-damaged item to absorb another hit. With no undamaged items remaining, ignore remaining hits.

source_passages.quotation: One hit damages one undamaged item of your choice; ignore excess hits when none remain.
Damaging an item sends it to Damaged box **without changing its face**.

answer.ruling: For each hit, choose one undamaged item; it is damaged and moved to the Damaged box.
evidence: Actions — Vagabond (9; V.1–3) (hit damage; damaged item handling)

answer.ruling: Damaging an item does not change its face. An already-damaged item cannot absorb another hit; if no undamaged items remain, ignore excess hits.
